subject: Final signature: approval stamp, escrow recipient, and clean-copy custody
body:
From: Mike Bryant <mike@brightwell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightwell Legal <legal@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: signature logistics - who retains clean PDF after signing?

Vanessa,

Thanks — we reviewed the latest MSA + Order Form that Marissa sent over. One quick operational ask from our side before we hit Send on DocuSign: Brightwell requires an approval stamp on the final signed PDF (for audit) and the contract needs to be held by our escrow partner (EscrowSafe) after execution. Who within Redwood will be the formal custody holder for the clean, signed PDF? Also, do you have a standard naming convention for the clean copy so our procurement tracker picks it up?

Attachments: Brightwell_Signer_Authority.pdf (pdf)

—Mike
Head of Procurement, Brightwell Health

-----Original Message-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Bryant <mike@brightwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: signature logistics - who retains clean PDF after signing?

Mike — thanks for the heads up. Short answers up front:
- Redwood legal ops will apply the approval stamp prior to handing off to EscrowSafe if Brightwell requests escrow custody.
- Standard clean-copy filename: Redwood_BW_MSA_OrderForm_v3.2_signed_20260805.pdf
- Custody handoff: Redwood Legal (Marissa) will deliver a certified clean copy to EscrowSafe and to your legal inbox; we will also place a copy in our internal retention Drive folder.

Plan for next 48 hours:
1) Marissa will confirm signer authority and add the approval stamp layer.
2) Karthik will create the DocuSign envelope with sequential routing (signer -> witness -> countersign) and include EscrowSafe as "CC - Custody" on completion.
3) I will queue the final clean-copy export and confirm the Drive delivery link.

If that works, we’ll generate the envelope tonight and route first thing Tuesday morning (PST).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Bryant <mike@brightwell.com>, Brightwell Legal <legal@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: signature logistics - who retains clean PDF after signing?

Vanessa / Karthik — updated commentary from Legal below. Key points:
- Approval stamp: we can apply a PDF-layered approval stamp (name, date, internal approver id) before finalizing the envelope. That stamp will be merged into the signed PDF (meets Brightwell audit ask).
- Escrow custody: Redwood will transmit a certified copy to EscrowSafe via SFTP. We need the SFTP account + recipient contact to push the file; Mike, can you confirm EscrowSafe contact and account id?
- Redline snapshot: there is one remaining clause change (Section 9.2) that Brightwell proposed; Marissa has noted it in the order form and confirms it was accepted by Commercial. The doc attached is v3.2 final.

I will prep the stamped clean copy and mark the document properties with a signature hash for traceability. I will also include a checksum file as part of the escrow delivery package.

Attachments: MSA_OrderForm_Brightwell_v3.2.docx (word)

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:10:00 -0700, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:

> Vanessa / Mike / Marissa —
> Confirming envelope plan and routing:
> - Envelope created tonight under account acct-RED-01.
> - Routing: Primary signer (Mike Bryant) -> Legal witness (Brightwell Legal) -> Countersign (Jonas Weber) -> Redwood finalizer (Marissa).
> - EscrowSafe will be added as a CC recipient to receive the completed PDF; SFTP transfer will follow from Redwood Legal.
> - We will enable DocuSign's "Certificate of Completion" and export the completed PDF with audit trail.
> - I will set the signing window to 72 hours (standard) and include a two-hour pause before finalizing the stamp to allow manual witness confirmation.
>
> DocuSign link (preview): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&acct=000-000
>
> Action items: Mike — confirm EscrowSafe SFTP account + point of contact; Marissa — prepare approval-stamped PDF and checksum; Vanessa — confirm filename and push to Drive once signed.
>
> Thanks,
> Karthik
> Director, Platform Operations

-----Original Message-----
From: Mike Bryant <mike@brightwell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: signature logistics - who retains clean PDF after signing?

Thanks — EscrowSafe contact below:
Account ID: ES-9802
SFTP host: sftp.escrowsafe.com
User: brightwell-es
Contact: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@escrowsafe.com>

We are good to proceed with the routing you described. Please ensure the checksum file is included in the SFTP drop and that the file name matches our tracker.

—Mike

-----Original Message-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Bryant <mike@brightwell.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: RE: signature logistics - who retains clean PDF after signing?

All — final update from Redwood side:
- Envelope sent 2026-08-05 10:58 PST.
- Signing complete 2026-08-05 10:59 PST (fast — thanks Mike).
- I exported the final signed PDF as: Redwood_BW_MSA_OrderForm_v3.2_signed_20260805.pdf (file attached in Drive and uploaded to our retention folder).
- Marissa applied the approval stamp and included the signature hash and checksum (sha256: 8b7f3e2a...). Checksum file: Redwood_BW_MSA_OrderForm_v3.2_signed_20260805.sha256.txt
- SFTP to EscrowSafe (ES-9802) initiated and completed 2026-08-05 11:00 PST. Jenna Morris confirmed receipt and provided a reference: ESCROWDROP-5489.

Attachments: signature-environment.png (screenshot of envelope settings)
Drive link (clean copy): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxxx-clean-copy
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/BW-2026-0897

If you need the certified PDF sent to any other mailbox, reply-all and I’ll push it immediately. Closing out on our side.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
